rows.grounds: first member describing hue; forms descriptive compound sense with ābhaḥ
having splendor or color; qualifies vasudevaḥ
past passive participle stating declared attribute

items.question: What distinctive hues are attributed to Vasudeva and Nanda respectively?
premises: Vasudeva is described as having a golden hue.
Nanda is described as being red.
items.inference: Vasudeva and Nanda are distinguished by their proclaimed golden and red hues.
items.plain_english: Vasudeva is indeed golden-hued, while Nanda is proclaimed to be red.
